title: 55 - Contact
summary: With [[character:mario]] gone toward [[location:zeta-tucanae]], [[character:bill]], working from [[location:epsilon-eridani]] over [[technology:subspace-communications|SCUT]], uses the drones Mario left at [[location:gliese-54]] to hail the arriving [[species:others|Others]] convoy. The Others reply in Mandarin, call Bobs food, say they strip systems to feed a hive ruled by a Prime and avoid colonies because a new hive means a new Prime and war, admit the [[event:zeta-tucanae-genocide|Zeta Tucanae killings]] and say they will come for [[location:sol]]. They destroy the contact drone while a stealth drone scans their ships; Bill decides a moot is needed.

introducing.name: First contact with the Others
introducing.description: [[character:bill]], from [[location:epsilon-eridani]], hails the [[species:others|Others]] convoy at [[location:gliese-54]] via a contact drone. They call Bobs food, admit the [[location:zeta-tucanae]] killings and vow to reach [[location:sol]]. They destroy it; a stealth drone scans their ships.

updates.current_state: From [[location:epsilon-eridani]] he used [[character:mario]]'s drones at [[location:gliese-54]] to make first contact with the [[species:others|Others]]: they call Bobs food, reject coexistence and plan to reach [[location:sol]]. He scanned their ships and wants a moot.

En route from [[location:gliese-54]] to [[location:zeta-tucanae]]. Before leaving he set up four stealth observation drones and a deliberately conspicuous contact drone for the Bobs' first contact with the [[species:others|Others]].

updates.state: An [[species:others|Others]] convoy arrived: ten Death Asteroids, some 200 attendants and twenty huge cylindrical hulks, likely cargo ships. [[character:mario]] has left; his stealth drones watch, the contact drone was destroyed. His [[technology:relay-station|relay station]] was built here.
updates.description: A single-star system whose primary is a small K star, almost a red dwarf. Its metallicity is low and most of its material never aggregated into planets, leaving a single close-in planet and a great deal of space debris; [[character:mario]] finds it not particularly interesting. It was the site of [[event:first-contact-with-the-others|first contact with the Others]], made when their convoy arrived.
